name: TortoiseBots Manager (client addon)
description: The in-game panel for the bots this server compiles in: /tbm opens it, and it drives the same .bot commands from a window instead of the chat box. Client-side only - it is copied into your WoW client's Interface/AddOns, nothing is written to the server.
notes: FOLLOWS RELEASES (T126): Install and Update take the newest published release's commit
(dated tags, v2026-09-25), not the branch tip. The addon publishes in lockstep with the
server module Sagiroth/TortoiseBots, which the wow-tortoise catalog entry also follows by
release, and its README says it degrades gracefully against an older server (TBM:CAPS).
REQUIRES THE SERVER-SIDE MODULE, and this entry's server already has it: TortoiseBots is
compiled into the image (`-DMODULE_TORTOISEBOTS=static`), so there is nothing to install
for it and nothing to put in `requires`, which names installable items. The addon's own
README states the dependency the other way round: "No module -> addon loads but every
action replies 'TortoiseBots module not loaded' from the server."
The addon speaks the module's `TBM:` protocol over `.bot` transport commands. That is not
a client-only protocol: `bot roster` typed at the worldserver CONSOLE answers
`TBM:ROSTER_ERROR|not-in-game|You must be in-game.` (measured, T30 Half 1, 08d), which is
also the shape of every bot command's refusal without a player session -- the addon is the
surface that HAS one.
Interface 11200 (Vanilla 1.12) against the 1.18.1 / build 7272 Turtle client, which is
what this entry's `client` block declares and what the client reports.
The whole checkout is copied, README and `tests/` included: `client` steps take a path
in the clone and this addon IS the repository root. WoW reads the `.toc` and the files
it lists and ignores the rest. Two names are left behind (T65): `.git`, whose 0444 pack
files made every SECOND install of this addon die with Errno 13 before it had landed a
file, and this app's own `.yulon-clone.json`. Both are bookkeeping, the history stays in
the clone, and the client never reads either.
WRITTEN AT INSTALL, not at Play. `_ApplyEngine._client()` (apply.py:2173-2192) is the one
writer into a client folder in this app, and it runs from the Modules tab's Install press;
Play launches the client it finds. The tab has to have been given a client dir for the
step to run at all -- on a record with none it is skipped with a sentence.
